item.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic fourth term
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, nearly 81 years old, clinched a fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 26). item.title: Perseverance offers clues to protect crews from ultrafine Mars dust
item.description: Over 1,645 Martian days, NASA's Perseverance Mars rover measured the fine and ultrafine Martian dust particles found clinging to samples of spacesuit materials that are carried aboard the rover, including particles small enough to penetrate the lungs and enter the bloodstream. The findings are published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences and could inform spacesuit and habitat design, dust-removal procedures and crew health standards for future NASA missions to Mars. Publicado también por: NASA. Fuente: Phys.org.

Repasamos los estados y municipios en los que se impuso, los niveles de participación así como los cambios en el voto blanco y nulo.
